mechanism: scope-safe proposal receipts and explicit public metrics omission

modifications: ProposalPool.receipt(scope) returns only the caller's session counts plus static contract metadata. Shared source health, global/model counts, aggregate revisions, retained-scope counts and evictions remain available only in unscoped internal/operator diagnostics.

Receipt reads share the critic lock with committed feedback. Shared critic predictions and admission learning remain intentionally unchanged; session privacy does not promise independent scheduling or independent learned priors.

With tenant authentication enabled, an unverified exempt metrics caller receives static metrics through explicit request-data omission, bypassing custom exporters. No caller-selectable tenant string stands in for an empty partition.

Verified tenants retain only their own request aggregates; authorized operators retain aggregate diagnostics. Without a tenant authenticator, legacy HTTP-gate-admitted scrapes intentionally retain aggregate metrics, while caller-chosen tenant headers are recorded in the default metrics namespace. This does not grant protected usage/admin authority. Existing loopback exemption and credential handling remain unchanged.

Real HTTP header/body drip tests allow five seconds for transport setup, then shorten the actual live budget to 150 milliseconds when the peer starts dripping. They still require transport interruption within one second and peer disconnect; aggregate operation budgeting remains covered separately by the deterministic shared-budget regression.
